grades.quote: This chapter defines the full set of CSR instructions that operate on these CSRs.
grades.reason: Introduces the Zicsr chapter that defines the CSR instructions, but it does not explain how CSRRS or CSRRC update a CSR.

grades.quote: Only the software-writable SEIP bit participates in the read-modify-write sequence of a CSRRS or CSRRC instruction.
grades.reason: Mentions that CSRRS and CSRRC perform a read-modify-write and uses the SEIP bit as an example. It does not describe the general set and clear semantics (rs1 as a bit mask).

grades.quote:
|CSRRS‡|rs1, csr|rd *, csr||*unless rs1=x0|
|CSRRC‡|rs1, csr|rd *, csr||*unless rs1=x0|
grades.reason: A memory-model register-dependency table. It shows that CSRRS and CSRRC read and write the CSR, with the write skipped when rs1=x0. It does not explain the set and clear bit semantics.

grades.quote: should preserve the values held in these fields when writing values to other fields of the same register.
grades.reason: Covers preserving the values of reserved fields when writing other fields of a CSR, and mentions read/modify/write and set-bit/clear-bit sequences. This is related background and does not describe CSRRS/CSRRC behavior directly.
